contract.default_policy: No unclassified defaults. Source defaults are recorded for reproduction only and do not become selected ARCANA values.
contract.ensemble_policy: Versioned, physically constrained model configurations with full member retention. Model-list/grid-search can run sensitivity only; no Earth OrbScore optimum is ARCANA authority.
contract.source_basis: ShellSet v1.1.0 paper documents four low-temperature friction parameters and nine crust/mantle dislocation-creep parameters in element groups; exact code-native symbols below cross-checked against Shells parameter literature, and must be validated against the pinned release before exporter implementation.
contract.viscosity_limits: No independent generic viscosity-limit field established by the reviewed minimum ShellSet contract; do not add one absent pinned source requirement.
